---
title: "AI Agents. Day 2"
---

Welcome to the deep-dive **Day 2** workshop. Over about 2–3 hours you'll turn a messy R project into an AER-compliant replication package using **Claude Code**. The handout covers plan mode, custom skills, hooks, permission allow-lists, research best practices (verification, referee-2, data privacy, reproducibility), and the full hands-on exercise.

::: {.callout-tip}
**New to coding agents?** The [Getting Started with Claude Code](../Getting_Started_Agents/) workshop (Day 1) is the gentler introduction: mental models, the basic interaction loop, and Claude Code setup (Max subscription or API tokens). Day 2 includes a short setup recap so you can follow along either way.
:::

## Materials

- [Tutorial](Tutorial/agent-workshop-howto.qmd). Full Claude Code walkthrough, plus **Appendix A: Using other models via Aider + OpenRouter** for when you need GPT-5, DeepSeek, Gemini, or a free-tier model.
- [Slides](Slides/agent-workshop-slides.qmd). Accompanying slide deck.

## About

This workshop was created for a small workshop on AI Agents in production.
